name: Ugoku Kemo Miko! Sono Shi
source:
The boy who met foxy shrine maidens Yama-chan and Gin-chan
has healthily had sex with them despite his worries typical of youth.
One rainy day, an unfamiliar girl waits for him in front of the entrance.
But she has cat ears and tail...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE232475.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
那个遇见狐狸巫女山酱与银酱的少年，尽管有着青春期特有的烦恼，仍健康地与她们发生了关系。

某个下雨天，一名陌生女孩在门口等着他。
可她有着猫耳和猫尾……

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE232475.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
